note: This packet supplies only en. The literal field and repeated uses were not supplied and are marked unchecked.

changes.exactBefore: After Duan Liao’s fall Murong Han fled to Yuwen Gui, reckoned his fame would never let him live, and feigned madness—drinking, singing, and disheveled hair.
changes.after: After Duan Liao's defeat, Jianwei [General] Murong Han fled to Yuwen Gui. Believing that his long-established fame and prestige would in the end keep him from surviving, he feigned madness, drinking without restraint, letting his hair hang loose, and singing and shouting.
changes.sourceReason: 建威 (his title, General Who Establishes Might) is omitted, and 威名夙振 (long-established fame) is flattened.

changes.exactBefore: Huang sent the trader Wang Che to spy; Murong Han met him in silence, only clutching his chest.
changes.after: Huang secretly sent the merchant Wang Che to observe Han; when Han saw Che he said nothing and only stroked his chest.
changes.sourceReason: 陰 (secretly) is omitted, and 撫膺 is stroking or patting the chest, not clutching it.
